Claim 2: L2a compares the learned allocator (greedy_warm) with the label-free agreement threshold at equal budget. The baseline has no free labels. Both 10% CIs include 1.0 (0.837–1.134 and 0.980–1.210). L10a also spans zero against a cross-fitted fixed comparator. Not supported. Claim 3: the L5c Skywork rm proxy is a different model and proxy from E01. Its embedding AUC gain is +0.003 (below 0.05) and its top-half cell100 neighbor ratio is 1.237 (below 1.5), so the kill condition is met. Other proxies show ratios of 1.67 to 2.09, but only on thin, cut-dependent subsets. The ledger does not conclude that claim 3 is supported or that claim 2 is supported, so W2 and W3 are false.
